statement: Let D be a compact connected oriented smooth four-manifold with connected boundary S and free fundamental group H. Suppose that D has the homotopy type of a finite graph with 2k two-spheres, and that its whole middle module H2( e D; Z) over ZH has a specified framed immersed hyperbolic basis of k planes, with vanishing quadratic self-intersections. Attach three-cells along the basis spheres to obtain a map of collared pairs (D, S) −→ (P, S) that is the identity on S and induces the given identification of fundamental groups. Assume that (P, S) is an oriented Poincaré pair of dimension four, that P ≃ BH, and that π1(S) → H is surjective. For a finite flag triangulation of S, let Q = RA(P) be (3.1). Then Q is a finite aspherical oriented Poincaré complex of dimension four. If Q has a closed topological four-manifold model, then S admits a marked graph-type filling: there is a compact oriented topological four- manifold V with an orientation-preserving boundary identification ∂V = S and a homotopy equivalence V → P whose boundary restriction is homotopic to the given inclusion S → P.
